description: Search and read the Shamela Arabic and Islamic book corpus from ChatGPT. The server resolves named books, authors, editions and categories, runs layered retrieval, and returns bounded original-source evidence with direct Shamela citations. Follow-up tools can search within explicit source or date constraints and open one or several source pages for context. Shamela is public and read-only, requires no user account, and does not call an AI model. Bounded retrieval does not prove completeness, consensus, attribution, hadith authenticity or scholarly correctness.
